figurative_meaning_bn: অনাদৃত ব্যক্তি; নীচব্যক্তি; নোংরামনের লোক- গালিবিশেষ
figurative_meaning_en: An unrespected or despised person; a lowly or base individual; a person of unclean habits - a specific insult
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আদাড়ের হাঁড়ির মতো নোংরা লোক।
এই আদাড়ের হাঁড়িকে কেউ স্পর্শ করবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He's a lowlife like Adar's pot.
No one would touch that dirty rat.
history: Originates from traditional Bengali societal norms where pots of low-caste or unclean individuals (আদাড়) were considered untouchable due to purity and hygiene taboos.
note: This idiom reflects historical caste and cleanliness prejudices in rural Bengal.
